fusions.name: Thunder Stoop
fusions.desc: A stooping dive deals 30 blunt damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Canter Click
fusions.desc: Sends a sonar click into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 resonating damage. Your movement speed rises 10% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spurred Flight
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Heartbeat Tempo
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
